a: The Sequence panel's "Adds" picker reads any non-actor head as "Participant", so a database/queue/boundary head cannot be set to a plain participant from it
The Sequence pickers and SequenceEdits' Activates/Deactivates show only the first selected item's value, so a mixed selection cannot be set to that value
File › Export › As DOT / draw.io is turned off by a page the export would never write, or would leave out with a warning
b: The Data panel keeps one chart's error note and open rows when the selection moves to another chart
The Sequence panel's Adds and Arrow pickers show the tool's value, not the selection's, when the selected head or message has a figure or arrow the picker doesn't name
The page tabs' add button adds a blank page, not "a page of the chart's own type" as ChartPageStrip says
Page Setup's target id is never cleared when its page goes away, so the dialog reopens if the page comes back
